lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਗੁਰੁ ਗੋਪੇ ਆਪਣਾ ਸੁ ਭਲਾ ਨਾਹੀ ਪੰਚਹੁ ਓਨਿ ਲਾਹਾ ਮੂਲੁ ਸਭੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: jo gur gope aapanaa s bhalaa naahee pa(n)chahu on laahaa mool sabh gavaaiaa ||
lines.translation: O chosen people, O self-elect, one who does not publicly affirm his Guru is not a good person; he loses all his profits and capital.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਹਿਲਾ ਆਗਮੁ ਨਿਗਮੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਆਖਿ ਸੁਣਾਏ ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਬਚਨੁ ਉਪਰਿ ਆਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: pahilaa aagam nigam naanak aakh sunaae poore gur kaa bachan upar aaiaa ||
lines.translation: People used to chant and recite the Shaastras and the Vedas, O Nanak, but now the Words of the Perfect Guru have come to be the most exalted of all.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਸਿਖਾ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਭਾਵੈ ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਕੀ ਮਨਮੁਖਾ ਓਹ ਵੇਲਾ ਹਥਿ ਨ ਆਇਆ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: gurasikhaa vadiaaee bhaavai gur poore kee manamukhaa oh velaa hath na aaiaa ||2||
lines.translation: The glorious greatness of the Perfect Guru is pleasing to the GurSikh; the self-willed manmukhs have lost this opportunity. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: pauRee ||
lines.translation: Pauree:

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਚੁ ਸਚਾ ਸਭ ਦੂ ਵਡਾ ਹੈ ਸੋ ਲਏ ਜਿਸੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਟਿਕੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: sach sachaa sabh doo vadaa hai so lae jis satigur tike ||
lines.translation: The True Lord is truly the greatest of all; he alone obtains Him, who is anointed by the Guru.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਜਿ ਸਚੁ ਧਿਆਇਦਾ ਸਚੁ ਸਚਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਇਕੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: so satigur j sach dhiaaidaa sach sachaa satigur ike ||
lines.translation: He is the True Guru, who meditates on the True Lord. The True Lord and the True Guru are truly One.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੋਈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਹੈ ਜਿਨਿ ਪੰਜੇ ਦੂਤ ਕੀਤੇ ਵਸਿ ਛਿਕੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: soee satigur purakh hai jin pa(n)je doot keete vas chhike ||
lines.translation: He is the True Guru, the Primal Being, who has totally conquered his five passions.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੇਵੇ ਆਪੁ ਗਣਾਇਦੇ ਤਿਨ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਕੂੜੁ ਫਿਟੁ ਫਿਟੁ ਮੁਹ ਫਿਕੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: j bin satigur seve aap ganaaide tin a(n)dar kooR phit phit muh phike ||
lines.translation: One who does not serve the True Guru, and who praises himself, is filled with falsehood within. Cursed, cursed is his ugly face.

lines.gurmukhi: ਓਇ ਬੋਲੇ ਕਿਸੈ ਨ ਭਾਵਨੀ ਮੁਹ ਕਾਲੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਚੁਕੇ ॥੮॥
lines.transliteration: oi bole kisai na bhaavanee muh kaale satigur te chuke ||8||
lines.translation: His words are not pleasing to anyone; his face is blackened, and he is separated from the True Guru. ||8||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੪ ॥
lines.transliteration: salok mah 4 ||
lines.translation: Salok, Fourth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਾ ਸਭੁ ਖੇਤੁ ਹੈ ਹਰਿ ਆਪਿ ਕਿਰਸਾਣੀ ਲਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: har prabh kaa sabh khet hai har aap kirasaanee laaiaa ||
lines.translation: Everyone is the field of the Lord God; the Lord Himself cultivates this field.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬਖਸਿ ਜਮਾਈਅਨੁ ਮਨਮੁਖੀ ਮੂਲੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: guramukh bakhas jamaaeean manamukhee mool gavaaiaa ||
lines.translation: The Gurmukh grows the crop of forgiveness, while the self-willed manmukh loses even his roots.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਬੀਜੇ ਆਪਣੇ ਭਲੇ ਨੋ ਹਰਿ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋ ਖੇਤੁ ਜਮਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: sabh ko beeje aapane bhale no har bhaavai so khet jamaaiaa ||
lines.translation: They all plant for their own good, but the Lord causes to grow only that field with which He is pleased.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਸਿਖੀ ਹਰਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਬੀਜਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਫਲੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: gurasikhee har a(n)mrit beejiaa har a(n)mrit naam phal a(n)mrit paaiaa ||
lines.translation: The GurSikh plants the seed of the Lord's Ambrosial Nectar, and obtains the Lord's Ambrosial Naam as his Ambrosial Fruit.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਮੁ ਚੂਹਾ ਕਿਰਸ ਨਿਤ ਕੁਰਕਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਕਰਤੈ ਮਾਰਿ ਕਢਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: jam choohaa kiras nit kurakadaa har karatai maar kadhaaiaa ||
lines.translation: The mouse of Death is continually gnawing away at the crop, but the Creator Lord has beaten it off and driven it away.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਿਰਸਾਣੀ ਜੰਮੀ ਭਾਉ ਕਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਬੋਹਲ ਬਖਸ ਜਮਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: kirasaanee ja(n)mee bhaau kar har bohal bakhas jamaaiaa ||
lines.translation: The farm was successful, by the Love of the Lord, and the crop was produced by God's Grace.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਿਨ ਕਾ ਕਾੜਾ ਅੰਦੇਸਾ ਸਭੁ ਲਾਹਿਓਨੁ ਜਿਨੀ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: tin kaa kaaRaa a(n)desaa sabh laahion jinee satigur purakh dhiaaiaa ||
lines.translation: He has removed all the burning and anxiety of those, who have meditated on the True Guru, the Primal Being.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਰਾਧਿਆ ਆਪਿ ਤਰਿਆ ਸਭੁ ਜਗਤੁ ਤਰਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: jan naanak naam araadhiaa aap tariaa sabh jagat taraaiaa ||1||
lines.translation: O servant Nanak, one who worships and adores the Naam, the Name of the Lord, swims across, and saves the whole world as well. ||1||

lines.transliteration: mah 4 ||
lines.translation: Fourth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਰਾ ਦਿਨੁ ਲਾਲਚਿ ਅਟਿਆ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਰੇ ਗਲਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: saaraa din laalach atiaa manamukh hore galaa ||
lines.translation: The self-willed manmukh is occupied with greed all day long, although he may claim otherwise.

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਾਤੀ ਊਘੈ ਦਬਿਆ ਨਵੇ ਸੋਤ ਸਭਿ ਢਿਲਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: raatee ooghai dabiaa nave sot sabh dhilaa ||
lines.translation: At night, he is overcome by fatigue, and all his nine holes are weakened.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖਾ ਦੈ ਸਿਰਿ ਜੋਰਾ ਅਮਰੁ ਹੈ ਨਿਤ ਦੇਵਹਿ ਭਲਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: manamukhaa dai sir joraa amar hai nit devahi bhalaa ||
lines.translation: Over the head of the manmukh is the order of the woman; to her, he ever holds out his promises of goodness.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋਰਾ ਦਾ ਆਖਿਆ ਪੁਰਖ ਕਮਾਵਦੇ ਸੇ ਅਪਵਿਤ ਅਮੇਧ ਖਲਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: joraa daa aakhiaa purakh kamaavade se apavit amedh khalaa ||
lines.translation: Those men who act according to the orders of women are impure, filthy and foolish.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਾਮਿ ਵਿਆਪੇ ਕੁਸੁਧ ਨਰ ਸੇ ਜੋਰਾ ਪੁਛਿ ਚਲਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: kaam viaape kusudh nar se joraa puchh chalaa ||
lines.translation: Those impure men are engrossed in sexual desire; they consult their women and walk accordingly.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਆਖਿਐ ਜੋ ਚਲੈ ਸੋ ਸਤਿ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਭਲ ਭਲਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: satigur kai aakhiai jo chalai so sat purakh bhal bhalaa ||
lines.translation: One who walks as the True Guru tells him to, is the true man, the best of the best.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋਰਾ ਪੁਰਖ ਸਭਿ ਆਪਿ ਉਪਾਇਅਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਖੇਲ ਸਭਿ ਖਿਲਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: joraa purakh sabh aap upaaian har khel sabh khilaa ||
lines.translation: He Himself created all women and men; the Lord Himself plays every play.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਭ ਤੇਰੀ ਬਣਤ ਬਣਾਵਣੀ ਨਾਨਕ ਭਲ ਭਲਾ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: sabh teree banat banaavanee naanak bhal bhalaa ||2||
lines.translation: You created the entire creation; O Nanak, it is the best of the best. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: pauRee ||
lines.translation: Pauree:

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਵੇਪਰਵਾਹੁ ਅਥਾਹੁ ਹੈ ਅਤੁਲੁ ਕਿਉ ਤੁਲੀਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: too veparavaahu athaahu hai atul kiu tuleeai ||
lines.translation: You are carefree, unfathomable and immeasurable; how can You be measured?

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੇ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਜਿ ਤੁਧੁ ਧਿਆਇਦੇ ਜਿਨ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲੀਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: se vadabhaagee j tudh dhiaaide jin satigur mileeai ||
lines.translation: Those who have met the True Guru and who meditate on You are very fortunate.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਸਤਿ ਸਰੂਪੁ ਹੈ ਗੁਰਬਾਣੀ ਬਣੀਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: satigur kee baanee sat saroop hai gurabaanee baneeai ||
lines.translation: The Word of the True Guru's Bani is the embodiment of Truth; through Gurbani, one becomes perfect.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਰੀਸੈ ਹੋਰਿ ਕਚੁ ਪਿਚੁ ਬੋਲਦੇ ਸੇ ਕੂੜਿਆਰ ਕੂੜੇ ਝੜਿ ਪੜੀਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: satigur kee reesai hor kach pich bolade se kooRiaar kooRe jhaR paReeai ||
lines.translation: Jealously emulating the True Guru, some others may speak of good and bad, but the false are destroyed by their falsehood.

lines.gurmukhi: ਓਨੑਾ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਹੋਰੁ ਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਰੁ ਹੈ ਬਿਖੁ ਮਾਇਆ ਨੋ ਝਖਿ ਮਰਦੇ ਕੜੀਐ ॥੯॥
lines.transliteration: onhaa a(n)dar hor mukh hor hai bikh maaiaa no jhakh marade kaReeai ||9||
lines.translation: Deep within them is one thing, and in their mouths is another; they suck in the poison of Maya, and then they painfully waste away. ||9||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੪ ॥
lines.transliteration: salok mah 4 ||
lines.translation: Salok, Fourth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਨਿਰਮਲੀ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਜਨੁ ਹੋਇ ਸੁ ਸੇਵਾ ਘਾਲੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: satigur kee sevaa niramalee niramal jan hoi s sevaa ghaale ||
lines.translation: Service to the True Guru is immaculate and pure; those humble beings who are pure perform this service.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਕਪਟੁ ਵਿਕਾਰੁ ਝੂਠੁ ਓਇ ਆਪੇ ਸਚੈ ਵਖਿ ਕਢੇ ਜਜਮਾਲੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: jin a(n)dar kapat vikaar jhooth oi aape sachai vakh kadhe jajamaale ||
lines.translation: Those who have deceit, corruption and falsehood within - the True Lord Himself casts them out like lepers.
